name: Caleb (son of Hezron)
title: Son of Hezron in the lineage of Judah
summary: Caleb was a son of Hezron in the lineage of Judah, not to be confused with Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, who was a spy. He is mentioned in the genealogy along with his wives Ashubah and Jerioth.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the lineage of Judah
keyEvents.description: Caleb, son of Hezron, is listed with his wives and children in the lineage of Judah.
